g.text: Start, Stop and fault shutdown across the audio components
(accepted while TX is configured, not started)
TX START with an empty queue fails,
block loop runs; the command queue is checked once per iteration
failed link, at once, no wait
STOP lets the block in DMA complete:
RX puts it into its queue, TX returns it
to the pool. Queued TX blocks are not played.
check 0 blocks in use in both pools
Fault: non-OK result in the loop
fault event with the failed link
